title: Point-line incidence Loewy compiler and Levi extension bridge
purpose: Use native GAP to factor the characteristic-three W33 and Q(4,3) adjacency radicals through literal point-line incidence, compute the induced maps on every Loewy layer, and determine whether the Q(4,3) fourteen-space is the Levi fourteen-space inside the nonsplit Pass4865 extension.

evidence.native_result: 9/9 checks; status=PASS inside the expanded Pass4949 46/46 carrier build

outcome: Literal point-line incidence has rank 25, factors both adjacency radicals, lowers the modular Loewy filtrations, identifies the line-side Q14 with the Levi L14, and factors the unique Pass4949 rank-14 forward map through incidence.
boundary: The shared owner is intentional and avoids a second coordinate realization. Incidence is a Loewy-lowering instruction, not a reversible point-line cast; it does not split L19, identify the middle homologies, or imply continuum, security, or hardware behavior.
